accessibility.evidence: Search and project controls have accessible labels; graph nodes expose button roles, accessible names and keyboard activation; the / shortcut focuses the search field with a visible focus ring. Search, refresh and zoom touch targets measured 44 px on mobile. Reduced-motion preference is honored. Secondary label colors were reviewed and low-emphasis labels were brightened.

responsive.evidence: Rendered at 1440x900 and 390x844; additionally checked 320x740. Document scroll height matched each viewport, there was no horizontal overflow, and the status bar remained visible at the viewport bottom.

loading.evidence: A delayed local project-list response showed the loading label, status and stable empty graph layout before completion.

empty.evidence: An empty project list cleared the graph, inspector provenance, endpoint count and pagination control.

error.evidence: A simulated local API failure displayed the recovery message and cleared the previously selected graph and request reference.

partial.evidence: The synthetic Go project returned partial surface coverage and an incomplete graph; the UI kept the partial coverage label visible.

success.evidence: The actual Go APIs loaded one endpoint, seven typed entities, six assertions and a local Caido request reference from a synthetic private project.

permission.evidence: Non-local Host requests received HTTP 421, mismatched Origin requests received HTTP 403, write methods received HTTP 405, and a wildcard listener was rejected.

renderedEvidence.observation: Three-pane graph view with the selected endpoint, seven nodes, six labeled relations, partial-coverage state and provenance inspector.
Responsive stacked endpoint list, graph canvas and inspector; no horizontal overflow and the bottom status bar remains visible.
Empty project state clears the previous selection and provenance while keeping the empty graph guidance visible.
